design_gotchas.title: 6.0 V Absolute Maximum Supply Limit — Destructive in 12 V / 24 V LM358 or TL072 SOIC-8 Sockets
design_gotchas.detail: TLV9062IDR shares the industry-standard dual SOIC-8 pinout with LM358DR (32 V abs max), TL072IDR (42 V), and NE5532DR (36 V), but has a strict 6.0 V absolute maximum supply rating (5.5 V operating max). Only install it on 1.8 V–5.5 V rails and ensure power-rail transients never exceed 6.0 V.

design_gotchas.title: 10 MHz GBWP Upgrade Over LMV358/TLV9002 Requires Tight Bypassing & Capacitive-Load Isolation
design_gotchas.detail: Replacing a 1 MHz LMV358IDR or TLV9002IDR with the 10 MHz, 6.5 V/µs TLV9062IDR increases loop bandwidth 10x. Place a 0.1 µF ceramic bypass capacitor directly across pins 4 and 8, keep feedback nodes compact, and insert an RISO series resistor when driving capacitive loads above 100 pF.

design_gotchas.title: 9x Higher Quiescent Current (~1.08 mA Total) vs TLV9002IDR and 32x vs OPA2333AIDR
design_gotchas.detail: At 538 µA/ch typ (750 µA/ch max at 25°C; 1.6 mA total max over temp), TLV9062IDR consumes nearly 9x more idle current than pin-compatible TLV9002IDR (60 µA/ch) and over 31x more than OPA2333AIDR (17 µA/ch), which can significantly shorten coin-cell or ultra-low-power IoT battery life.

design_gotchas.title: Complementary RRIO Input Crossover Drops Full-Range CMRR from 103 dB to 87 dB Typ
design_gotchas.detail: CMRR is 103 dB typ (80 dB min) for VCM < (V+) - 1.4 V, but degrades to 87 dB typ (57 dB min) across the full -0.1 V to 5.6 V input swing due to NMOS/PMOS input-stage handoff. For crossover-free DC precision on SOIC-8, consider OPA2333AIDR.

typical_use_cases: High-speed 1.8 V–5.5 V dual SAR ADC input buffers and active anti-aliasing filters
Motor-control dual-phase low-side shunt current sensing in HVAC and e-bike controllers
High-impedance photodiode, pH, and CMOS sensor front-ends requiring 0.5 pA bias current
Pin-compatible 10 MHz RRIO bandwidth upgrade for 3.3 V/5 V LMV358IDR or TLV9002IDR SOIC-8 sockets
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV9062IDR is a dual 10 MHz, 6.5 V/µs, rail-to-rail input and output (RRIO) CMOS operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (-40°C to +125°C). Offering ±0.3 mV typical offset (±1.6 mV max), 0.5 pA input bias current, 10 nV/√Hz noise at 10 kHz (16 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz), internal EMI/RFI filtering, and ±50 mA short-circuit output drive, it serves as a high-speed SOIC-8 candidate upgrade for 3.3 V/5 V LMV358IDR and TLV9002IDR circuits provided the 6.0 V absolute maximum ceiling and 538 µA/ch quiescent current fit the system budget.
